accepted_warns.why: 1.1 mm ledges round the M4 hole in the roof of the fin-to-tray nut slots (inboard halves); under the 3 mm limit

45 deg undersides of the fin-bolt, cover and land bosses (SDF facets read 44.7-44.9 deg), the crown of the oblique Ø14 bit hole through the floor (~345 mm2, 14 mm span) and the lower and upper M5 hole and counterbore crowns (~78 + 63 mm2, reviewer a3 overhang map); printcheck max bridge 2.8, max ledge 0.9
the lead is modelled from the boss axis; its first 15 mm is the cell's own boss
jumper ends modelled at the header pin centres
ESP32 screws by the tray's front wall: the drill body needs to be above the wall, so a 150 mm 1/4 in hex extension (README tools); done on the bench before the tray goes on
designed: 150 mm 1/4 in hex extension + 4 mm hex bit through the Ø14 hole in the tray floor along the bolt axis (reviewer a2 #9 fix); no L-key

cartridges: the 1.5 mm flexure leaves (thin by design, they are the springs) and 1.22 mm between the piston-screw counterbores and the top link's 45 deg chamfer (unchanged since a3, no load across it)

first layers at the downward point of the teardrop doubler rings round the stop-key holes (1.5 proud of each leaf face, 45 deg outline); 0.7-0.9 mm2, under the 3 mm limit; layer map cad/review/a4_designer/cartridge_R_z013.4_cantilever.png

E-shaped roof at x' 18.1 over the cartridge's plate, post and ground pockets, every arm anchored on both sides: the post-pocket roof bridges its 22.5 mm side, the plate and ground strips 3-7 mm; 67 mm is the E's length. Layer map cad/review/a4_designer/fin_R_outboard_z018.0_bridge.png

C-shaped roof at x' 19: the two leaf slots (6.5 wide, widened for the R1.5 root fillets) and the top-link cavity side (15.2 tall, 45 deg chamfers above and below); all arms anchored both sides. Layer map cad/review/a4_designer/fin_R_outboard_z019.0_bridge.png
